query: does the synthetic assignment raise the outcome
note: Synthetic analysis with a complete identification argument: the assignment is recorded before the outcome, the confounder set is declared, the estimand is named, a robustness check ran, evidence points at the generated dataset, and no identification assumption is left untested. attempt.title: The synthetic assignment raises the synthetic outcome
attempt.body:
Synthetic experiment (generated, not observed people). Assignment A/B is randomised; the outcome is measured after assignment; the declared confounder set is empty by design and the balance check ran.

| arm | n | mean outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 1000 | 3.40 |
| B | 1000 | 2.10 |

The identification argument is stated below, the robustness check ran, and the dataset is the recorded source.
